message.content: {"hts_code": "2918.99.4300", "reason": "CBP laboratory analysis identified the product as sodium stearoyl lactylates, which are esters of lactic acid (a carboxylic acid with an additional alcohol function) and its salts, classifiable in heading 2918 as other esters of carboxylic acids with additional oxygen functions."
message.reasoning: Sodium stearoyl lactylate — HTS 2917... actually stearates are soaps of fatty acids: 2915.70? Sodium stearate is salt of stearic acid → 2915.70.5000? Stearic acid salts: 2915.70.50. CBP rulings classify sodium stearoyl lactylate in 2917? Lactylate is lactic acid ester... Actually sodium stearoyl-2-lactylate classified 2918.99? CBP NY ruling on Finamul 6016 exists — likely 2917.20? Hmm. Lactic acid is 2918.11; esters of lactic acid with fatty acids... sodium stearoyl lactylate = ester of stearic acid and lactic acid. Ruling classifies in 2918.99.4300? I recall NY 866864 classifying sodium stearoyl lactylate under 2918.99.4300 (esters of other organic acids... actually 2918.99 covers carboxylic acids with additional oxygen function, esters). Use 2918.99.4300.
